newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DEXIA CC TO ENTER BEL-20 -PAPER.
newsitem.headline: DEXIA CC TO ENTER BEL-20 -PAPER.

text.p: Belgian bank Dexia CC will replace diversified shipping group CMB in the Bel-20 index of leading shares from December 19, the Belgian daily De Financieel Economische Tijd said on Friday.
Bourse officials were not immediately available for comment.

The Tijd said Dexia CC was meeting all the conditions for inclusion after showing its turnover had been in the Brussels top-20 at least eight months of of 12. CMB met all the conditions to be replaced, it said.

Dexia was in the top-20 for the eighth successive month with a turnover of about 4.7 billion francs in July, the paper said. CMB by contrast, with an estimated turnover of 1.2 billion francs last month, had not been in the top-20 since December last year.
Dexia also clearly outperformed CMB on bourse capitalisation and liquidity criteria, it said.
Each year the bourse reviews the composition of the Bel-20 in December, adjusting it to take into account of the year's trading volumes and market capitalisation at the end of November.

Thirty-five percent of Dexia CC was listed on the Brussels bourse last November, too late for it to be included in 1996's review. An additional 15 precent was sold in June in a secondary offering, further increasing the company's free float and liquidity of its shares.
Dexia CC is the partner bank of France's Credit Local de France. The two took cross holdings in each other's capital last year.
